Ordinary-risk template shape for a target

Source: R/quiet.R
ec_quiet_shape.Rd

Predicts a target surface's smile shape from earlier quiet surfaces, for one or more template rules. Only library surfaces whose whole option life ended at or before cutoff are eligible, so no information from after the target's valuation date enters. The target contributes only its valuation date, expiry, at-the-money volatility (which sets the level and ranks templates for atm<n> rules), and the moneyness points to predict at — never its wings.

Usage

ec_quiet_shape(
  library,
  date,
  expiry,
  atm_iv,
  k,
  rules = ec_quiet_rules(),
  cutoff = date,
  exclude_block = NULL,
  tau = NULL
)

Arguments

library

An ec_quiet_library().

date, expiry

Target valuation date and expiry (Date or POSIXct).

atm_iv

Target at-the-money implied volatility.

k

Log-forward moneyness points at which to predict.

rules

Rule table from ec_quiet_rules().

cutoff

Templates must have expired at or before this time (default: the target's date); NULL disables the restriction (for a fixed, already pre-target library).

exclude_block

Maturity block(s) to leave out.

tau

Target time to expiry in years, used with a standardized library (default: calendar days to expiry / 365).

Value

A tibble with one row per rule and point k: rule, k, z (standardized moneyness; NA without a target ATM level), shape (median template shape; NA where no template covers k), iv_pred (target ATM volatility combined with the shape), n_templates (templates covering k), n_selected (templates the rule selected), and threshold (clock threshold applied). The attribute templates lists the selected surfaces per rule.

See also

ec_quiet_select().

Examples

nodes <- expand.grid(i = 1:6, k = c(-0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2))
nodes$surface <- paste0("s", nodes$i)
nodes$date <- as.Date("2024-09-02") + 7 * (nodes$i - 1)
nodes$expiry <- nodes$date + 4
nodes$A <- c(0.01, 0.30, 0.02, 0.25, 0.03, 0.40)[nodes$i]
# quiet surfaces carry a symmetric smile, busy ones an added skew
nodes$iv <- 0.5 + 0.8 * nodes$k^2 - ifelse(nodes$A > 0.1, 0.3 * nodes$k, 0)
lib <- ec_quiet_library(nodes)
ec_quiet_shape(lib, date = as.Date("2024-10-14"), expiry = as.Date("2024-10-18"),
               atm_iv = 0.55, k = c(-0.1, 0.1),
               rules = ec_quiet_rules(0.5, aggregation = "all"))
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   rule                    k     z shape iv_pred n_templates n_selected threshold
#>   <chr>               <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl>       <int>      <int>     <dbl>
#> 1 p50 | any DTE | all  -0.1 -1.74 8.e-3   0.558           3          3      0.14
#> 2 p50 | any DTE | all   0.1  1.74 8.e-3   0.558           3          3      0.14
